item.title: First font purchase - Cern &Cern Display
item.description: I’ll be short: Cern & Cern Display are my choice. I may buy Vaud & Vaud Display as well. Price: The entire Cern family (40 weights) is available for $49 for a limited time. (same price for 40 weights of Vaud family). I intend to buy them instead of Helvetica Neue (just need something helvetica-ish, neutral, familiar, relatively modern looking, a bit unusual, rare etc. for personal use and some occasional website design).
